title: Terraform Run
description: A Terraform run represents a single instance of a plan and optional apply cycle for a workspace.

message.description: Human-readable message explaining why the run was triggered

is-destroy.description: When true, this run will destroy all managed resources

auto-apply.description: When true, the run automatically applies after a successful plan

refresh.description: Whether Terraform should refresh state before planning

created-at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the run was created

has-changes.description: Whether the plan detected any resource changes

resource-additions.description: Number of resources to be added

resource-changes.description: Number of resources to be changed

resource-destructions.description: Number of resources to be destroyed

workspace.description: The workspace this run belongs to

plan.description: The plan associated with this run

apply.description: The apply associated with this run
